item.title: aa1143/NamiGPT: Build GPT-2 from scratch in PyTorch, step by step
item.description: NamiGPT. 零基础入门大模型（LLM）的基础教程. 从零手写 GPT-2，一行行看懂大模型是怎么工作的. 图文教程 · 快速开始 · 在线可视化 · 作者 𝕏. 不需要大模型基础，会一点 Python、懂矩阵乘法这样的线性代数基础就够了。我们用 PyTorch 从零手写一个 GPT-2，加载 OpenAI 官方权重，跑通推理和文本生成。. 不调用任何现成的 Transformer 模块，模型代码 gpt2/model.py 不到 200 行. 用一个 3 个词的例子「猫吃鱼」，从分词一路推到文本生成，每篇都配可运行脚本. 和 HuggingFace 官方实现逐项对齐，测试保证结果一致. 学之前，先看这两份可视化. Why it matters: A hands-on walkthrough for readers following LLMs who want to see how GPT-2 works in code.

item.title: Houston millionaires on building wealth and business advice from houston's rich
item.description: Several Houston residents interviewed in person, including a business owner of 22 years and an energy-sector entrepreneur, with no net worth stated by them. Their advice: 1. Find a business that pays you recurring income every month, instead of chasing one-time sales. 2. Save money early, since compound interest is the greatest force in the universe. 3. Figure out what you are good at and do that, rather than following your passion. 4. Do not walk into a room asking what they can do for you; ask how you can serve them. 5. Pay attention to red flags instead of ignoring them because you want something so badly. Why it matters: Touches advice from founders and the wealthy.
